Temporarily select screen variant six, initialize effect state three and rendering, then update the effect and OAM every frame until it returns to state one. Copy the effect's two sixteen-bit coordinates into sprite arguments, select its sprite set and tail-call the fixed metasprite builder. Round the target vertical coordinate to a four-unit grid and move the object by two on each differing axis. Return the OR of remaining coordinate differences so callers can wait for alignment. Scan five particle-state slots backward; return Y zero when all are inactive. For each active particle choose its frame and coordinates from the selected layout, draw it and advance its phase only when the shared timer reaches zero. Clear the slot after its final frame. Use each slot's phase to read a coordinate sequence and draw its sprite. A zero coordinate pair starts a thirty-tick pause and sound $65; delayed slots use the waiting frame until their delay expires. regions.summary: Build the six-team standings screen. Resolve stored rank groups, use a secondary field to order ties, render team ids and three derived number fields and queue six twenty-two-tile rows at $60-byte PPU strides. The following helpers calculate the tie-break value and construct the ordered team-id list. For each of six teams resolve its persistent record and sum the selected ten fields to form the secondary ordering value. Select teams by increasing stored rank. Within each rank group repeatedly choose the largest secondary value, remove that candidate and append its id to the six-entry display order. Render two six-field rows for each team from its persistent record, skipping its self column. Format each value as three digits separated by fixed tiles and advance the PPU row addresses before the next team. Choose ordinary or extended team range, scan six eight-byte pitcher records per team and insert nonzero field-1/2 values into the ten-entry ranking list. Resolve equal ranks and pass category zero to the banked summary renderer. Scan eighteen player records per team and rank the nonzero little endian word in fields six/seven, then swap displayed pair order, resolve ties and render category four. Scan eighteen player records per team and rank the nonzero word in fields four/five, then normalize display ordering and render category five. Copy the saved fourteen-byte score history, render up to seven score pairs and mark the winning side. Count per-side results and append both totals; this static renderer is not runtime proof of terminal completion.

regions.summary: Toggle the local frame state and request its sound when visible. The adjacent input predicate maps A presses and automatic control modes to the requesting team, then validates whether a substitution is available at the current batting-order position. Clear pending team changes and reject the selected side's final batting-order case only when all six reserve availability fields are nonzero. Return one when the menu remains available. Update the play result, counts and plate-appearance flags. If outs did not change, examine occupied-base actor flags; other paths adjust strike count, clear bases, reconstruct occupancy from four actor records and refresh the next batter. For each occupied base, test its associated actor flags and increment the relevant result counter when the retained flag mask allows it. Suppressed updates clear frame cadence. Otherwise live flag $10 and frame bit two choose cadence $0F or $20. Set the object-frame wait argument to $0020 and repeatedly run the fixed frame service until it returns a nonzero or negative result. Set runner object states, advance the occupied-base chain and carry each base's associated player id forward. Return any displaced final occupant for the scoring caller.

units.name: B7_PpuEmitZeroPaddedDigits
units.summary: Initialize a seven-byte digit source, skipping leading zeros, then share the paired-digit output loop.

units.name: B7_PpuEmitIndexedDigits
units.summary: Resolve the indexed digit source for each continuation. $48 encodes byte index and half phase; use the fill tile for skipped zeros and advance the stream only after all fields complete.

units.name: B7_PpuEmitDigitPairLoop
units.summary: Read and emit one digit/fill phase, advance the encoded progress, then finalize or yield according to stream mode and queue budget.

units.name: B7_PpuEmitDoubledInlineTiles
units.summary: Duplicate each inline tile into two queue bytes. Token count zero means sixteen; preserve progress across yields and advance past the complete payload only when its count finishes.

units.name: B7_PpuSaveCoordinates
units.summary: Flush pending output and run the indexed coordinate-save loop into $013B. The flush helper returns locally only with X=0; the following LDA #$03 does not load X, so this path saves only coordinate byte zero on that return. The restore command later reads four bytes; retain this exact asymmetry rather than inventing an LDX.

units.name: B7_PpuCallNestedStream
units.summary: Push a two-byte target from the stream into the active source pointer and save the return source at $0139/$013A. This is a single saved continuation, not an inferred recursive stack.

units.name: B7_PpuEmitRepeatedTile
units.summary: Use A as repeat count, initialize the output address when needed, and emit the fill tile until progress matches the count. Preserve partial progress across mode/budget yields.

units.name: B7_PpuRepeatWithExplicitCount
units.summary: Read the count byte; mode $80 adjusts the continuation based on existing progress, otherwise share the ordinary repeat path.

units.name: B7_PpuRestoreCoordinates
units.summary: Flush pending output and restore the four saved coordinate bytes before continuing the stream.

units.name: B7_PpuReturnNestedStream
units.summary: Restore the single saved source pointer, update memory access and resume at its first byte.

units.name: B7_PpuSetModeBitWhenIdle
units.summary: Set attribute/mode bit 7 only when low seven bits are clear, advance and resume.

units.name: B7_PpuWaitForControllerMask
units.summary: Read a controller mask and alternate tile; choose controller by $5F. Matching input advances past parameters. While waiting, blink using progress bit 4 and emit one tile through the normal queue path.

units.name: B7_PpuSetDelayOrMode
units.summary: Read one parameter: high values select mode bits; $BF recalls the saved delay. Swap the current delay through $013F where required, then update active delay and continue.

units.name: B7_PpuBeginNextControl
units.summary: Flush pending output before entering the following already-classified control handler.
